hero.title: Building an Excellent Generation of
hero.description: An in-depth research project on the digital competency of Vietnamese students in a globalized context, aimed at building a safe, creative, and responsible digital environment.

objectives.title: Research Objectives
items: Comprehensively assess the current awareness and behavior of Vietnamese students in cyberspace.
Identify digital skill gaps that need to be addressed in higher education programs.
Propose a set of "Digital Citizen 2.0" standards suitable for Vietnam's culture and development direction.

significance.title: Practical Significance
significance.description: The research results provide valuable data for policymakers and universities in building soft skills and digital skills training programs for the 4.0 era.

methodology.title: Research Methodology
methodology.subtitle: Multi-dimensional approach ensuring objectivity and scientific rigor.

methods.title: Quantitative
methods.description: Extensive survey with over 5,000 samples from 20 major universities nationwide through standardized questionnaires.

methods.title: Qualitative
methods.description: In-depth interviews and focus group discussions (FGD) with cybersecurity experts, lecturers, and representative student groups.

methods.title: Document Research
methods.description: Synthesis and analysis of international digital competency frameworks (UNESCO, DigComp) compared with Vietnam's context.
